Gahawa insertion gives jaħafadˤak, and the weight rule then stresses its antepenult. Allah has a long final vowel, so it is CVVC and takes final stress (alˈlaːh, walˈlaːh). The A/B reading is correct and the engine is wrong.
C.note_conflict: The interdentals note allows ظ to stay [ðˤ]. This reading writes only the merged stop dˤ, following Jullien de Pommerol 1999 and Owens 2006 p.25.
